segments.name: Enterprise
segments.evidence: Market area Other primarily includes IPR licensing revenues and segment Enterprise sales.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for network hardware, software licenses, subscription and usage-based cloud services, managed services and IPR royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: IPR contracts are usually structured as a royalty fee based on sales or usage over the period, measured on a quarterly basis.

changes.text: In 2024 Ericsson decided to exit a number of enterprise areas.
changes.evidence: Following the decision in 2024 to exit a number of areas, it was encouraging to see that we returned to year-over-year growth while strengthening the gross margin in Q4.

changes.text: In 2025 Ericsson sold iconectiv, generating a gain.
changes.evidence: Excluding the gain from the iconectiv sale, the EBITA margin was 14.9%, bringing us close to our long-term ambition.
